title: WebSocket Chat Server
description: Build a real-time chat server with REST endpoints for sending messages and retrieving history, plus a WebSocket for live messaging.

steps.title: Health check endpoint
steps.description: Create a GET /health endpoint that returns JSON with status ok.

steps.title: Send message via REST
steps.description: Create a POST /chat/send endpoint that accepts JSON with a username and message, stores it, and returns 201.
hints: Use app.post('/chat/send', handler) with express.json() middleware
Assign an id and store in an array, return 201

steps.title: Retrieve message history
steps.description: Add a GET /chat/messages endpoint that returns all stored messages with status 200.
hints: Return the messages array as JSON

steps.title: WebSocket for real-time chat
steps.description: Add a WS /chat endpoint that upgrades to WebSocket and broadcasts messages to all connected clients.
hints: Use express-ws or a ws library to handle WebSocket connections
Track all connected clients in a Set or array
On receiving a message, broadcast to all connected clients
